decision: Make the general StoryPackage matching contract the first fail-closed harness stage.
source: User directed that everything done must serve a general matching layer flexible enough for any StoryPackage.
scope: Story, Data, Media, Matching, human-feedback reconciliation and harness acceptance.
reason: A documentary-specific fixture and task plan could previously pass most harness stages without proving reusable cross-story behavior.

decision: Treat exact human feedback as story/task scoped until explicit reusable-rule reconciliation and cross-story testing.
source: User clarified that current review work must update a general system rather than merely fix the current story.
scope: Candidate admissions, rejections, selections, B-roll rulings, comments and ordering evidence.
reason: Copying a reviewed candidate into one task is useful evidence but is not systematic learning and must not contaminate another StoryPackage.

decision: Reclassify Future Volksgeist from held-out acceptance to calibration/regression after using it to tune the system.
source: Audit of the current recalibration work.
scope: Generality evidence and the next required acceptance run.
reason: A package used to diagnose and change rules is no longer untouched; counting it as held out would fabricate generality evidence.

decision: Leave selection and rendering unauthorized while updating the harness and Story/Matching contracts.
source: Existing deterministic selection and render policy.
scope: All packages and candidate galleries covered by this harness update.
reason: The change verifies reusable matching architecture and does not constitute template selection, native fit proof or render authorization.
